title: Cancellation and hold
summary: Abort holds the host until the interrupted case records starting_state_restore. Declared baselines require restored=true; as_is or no-baseline cases use a no-restore receipt. Other cases add no restore obligations. Missing proof or failed cleanup/restoration retains custody and names recovery. Removal and takeover record this abort; run cancellation leaves recorded aborts to their cleanup. A removed mission releases its host only through walk-end (qa_abort_walk_end_required). After a terminal deployment run, the original session can abort or finish walk-end; the release reason records run status. Settled executions report their state. Ordinary writes require the active stage.
